title: The Green Report: Worst COP ever? What went down at 2026 UN climate talks
summary: Catch this episode on Wednesday, November 25, at 5 pm

blocks.text: Catch this episode on Wednesday, November 25, at 5 pm
MANILA, Philippines – The climate talks in Turkey collapsed, ending without a cover decision. Around 90 countries opposed the Antalya Pact, primarily for its lack of mention of fossil fuels.

Disappointment and frustration over the failure of COP31 were expressed in many countries, especially by climate activists. But a silver lining some see in the outcome is the strong opposition against a watered-down text. As the notion goes, “No deal is better than a bad deal.”
Rappler’s Jee Geronimo and Iya Gozum talk about what went down at COP31 and the ways forward. Catch this episode on Wednesday, November 25, at 5 pm. – Rappler.com
